test_diff_duration_dtype: test the polars diff function on a date column to verify duration comparisons with duration(days=1)
test_diff_scalarity: test the polars diff function with scalar and non-scalar arguments to verify ShapeError and correct computation
test_diff_with_shift: test the polars diff function with a shift parameter to compute N-step differences on an integer column
test_diff_on_date_series: test the polars diff function on a datetime series to compute day-level differences between consecutive dates
test_diff_with_mean_scalar: test the polars diff function using a computed mean scalar as the shift argument on a DataFrame column
